name: Coauthoring
description: Contains properties and methods for manipulating co authoring in a presentation.
remarks: The Presentation.Coauthoring property returns a Coauthoring object.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: MergeMode
properties.description: Returns True if the application is in merge mode. Read-only.

properties.name: FavorServerEditsDuringMerge
properties.description: Gets or sets whether the merged document favors server-side edits when conflicts occur. Read/write.

properties.name: PendingUpdates
properties.description: Returns True if merge-mode updates are pending. Read-only.

methods.name: EndReview
methods.description: Terminates merge mode and ends the review.
